title: feat: integrate Stripe SDK for payment intents
head: SyntaxHQDEV:feat/stripe-integration
body:
This PR implements the Stripe SDK integration for the payment service.

### Changes
- Installed `stripe` package.
- Replaced mock implementation with `stripe.paymentIntents.create` using the 2023-10-16 API version.
- Added automatic payment methods mapping.

Please process bounty payout to the following wallet address:
**Wallet (EVM):** `0x7F603CD46BC9C2ff735b8B347ed9F19430A0A131`
